title: Cadence calibration and executive synchronization playbook for monthly roadmap reviews
creator: Ava Chen
description: Purpose: Create a repeatable, lightweight playbook to align product, eng, and GTM for monthly roadmap readouts and quarterly exec/QBRs. The playbook will reduce last-minute deck rework, surface true risks earlier, and create a single source of truth for decision asks and fallback lanes. Scope: monthly roadmap syncs, prep cadence for QBRs and Board readouts, artifact templates (one-pager, decision appendix, risk heatmap), and a lightweight evidence pack for engineering/infra bets. Outcomes: 1) 30% reduction in deck revision cycles prior to exec readouts, 2) standardized decision log and ask format, 3) a delegated escalation lane and on-call owner for emergent tradeoff decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc published in Confluence with templates (one-pager, decision appendix, risk heatmap)
Two pilot monthly readouts run with playbook and retrospective notes captured
Deck revision cycles reduced in pilot by >= 20% vs prior two months
Decision log template adopted by Product and Eng leads and surfaced in Console for audit
